developmentObservations: CMake compilation and link strings include terminal newlines and must be decoded passively without treating them as embedded commands.
Native DWARF file tables can alias the primary source and omit hashes for SDK startup files; conflicting project aliases and consumed project header hashes remain rejected.
CTest JUnit containers include whitespace text nodes; physical registrations and native console/result counters are separately reconciled.
A standard string-heavy use-after-move fixture exceeded the shared output bound; the original fixture was reduced while preserving a native analyzer defect and its repair.
Clang default configuration and CCC override diagnostics required explicit no-default-config version collection and the protected quiet override.
Selecting the division analyzer enables native required core checkers. The full native checker list is reconciled; individual defects are not claimed for every core checker.
Reached native callbacks that mutate a generated header or linked executable invalidate artifact freshness even when original source is unchanged.
